out, err = process.communicate()

env_yaml = out.decode('utf-8')

simplified_env_yaml = re.sub(r'([a-zA-Z0-9\-_]+=[0-9a-zA-Z\.\_]+)=.*', r'\1', env_yaml)
# Write the simplified environment file
with open("environment.yml", "w") as file:
    file.write(simplified_env_yaml)
